resources.string: Stylus button mappings
Record a button, then assign a tool or action. Mappings apply inside the editor only. Tool changes during a stroke wait until the pen lifts.
No buttons recorded yet. Record your stylus buttons to assign them a tool or action.
Record a button
Within 15 seconds, hover over the area below, press ONE button and release it. If nothing happens, hold the button and touch the area, then release. Keyboard-style pen keys can also be recorded.

For a button with a double-press action, a press that picks a tool or runs a command waits this long for a second press. Holding still starts at once.
